# `try_add`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the sum of `expr1`and `expr2` and the result is null on overflow. The acceptable input types are the same with the `+` operator.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
try_add(expr1, expr2)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.2.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- try_add, example 1
> SELECT try_add(1, 2);
3
```

```sql
-- try_add, example 2
> SELECT try_add(2147483647, 1);
NULL
```

```sql
-- try_add, example 3
> SELECT try_add(date'2021-01-01', 1);
2021-01-02
```

```sql
-- try_add, example 4
> SELECT try_add(date'2021-01-01', interval 1 year);
2022-01-01
```

```sql
-- try_add, example 5
> SELECT try_add(timestamp'2021-01-01 00:00:00', interval 1 day);
2021-01-02 00:00:00
```

```sql
-- try_add, example 6
> SELECT try_add(interval 1 year, interval 2 year);
3-0
```
